definitions.explanation: The academic department at a university that covers the natural sciences such as physics, chemistry, biology, and mathematics.

examples.japanese: {理学部|りがくぶ}で{物理|ぶつり}を{学|まな}んでいる。
examples.english: I am studying physics in the faculty of science.

examples.japanese: {弟|おとうと}は{理学部|りがくぶ}の{化学科|かがくか}に{進|すす}んだ。
examples.english: My younger brother went into the chemistry department in the faculty of science.

examples.japanese: {理学部|りがくぶ}の{建物|たてもの}は{実験室|じっけんしつ}が{多|おお}いので、{他|ほか}の{学部|がくぶ}より{広|ひろ}い。
examples.english: The science faculty building is larger than other faculties because it has many laboratories.

notes:
A compound of {理|り} (science/reason) and {学部|がくぶ} (faculty). Covers pure sciences as opposed to {工学部|こうがくぶ} (engineering), which focuses on applied sciences. Some universities combine them as {理工学部|りこうがくぶ} (faculty of science and engineering).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {理学部|りがくぶ}の{教授|きょうじゅ}: science faculty professor
- {理学部|りがくぶ}{数学科|すうがくか}: mathematics department (within science)
- {理学部|りがくぶ}を{志望|しぼう}する: to aspire to the science faculty

RELATED WORDS:
- {工学部|こうがくぶ}: faculty of engineering
- {理工学部|りこうがくぶ}: faculty of science and engineering (combined)
- {理学|りがく}: science (the discipline)
- {学部|がくぶ}: faculty; department
